name: toggle-group
blurb: Group of toggle buttons with shared size and style variants.
description: Toggle group built on Radix UI for managing multiple toggles with shared styling. Supports single or multiple selection via type prop. ToggleGroupItem respects parent size and variant.
use_when: Building toolbar button groups, text formatting controls with multiple options, or segmented controls.
avoid_when: When you need mutually exclusive radio buttons. Use RadioGroup for that.
a11y: Built on Radix UI ToggleGroup with proper aria-pressed handling and focus management across items.
